subject.title: feat(tui): inline image rendering via pi-tui Image component

question: May the TUI render MEDIA paths by reading absolute local image files from tool output, or must inline rendering be limited to trusted media-store/base64 payloads?
rationale: The implementation direction changes a security-sensitive local read boundary and user-visible TUI delivery behavior, and the protected `maintainer` label plus canonical issue mark this as a human product/security choice rather than an automation-only repair.

options.title: Approve with guardrails
options.body: Allow local MEDIA reads only after the branch is rebased, fallback/dedupe defects are fixed, and live proof covers image-capable and unsupported terminals.

options.title: Restrict to trusted payloads
options.body: Require the implementation to render only trusted media-store or base64 image payloads and leave arbitrary host-local path reads out of the TUI renderer.

options.title: Close and keep canonical issue
options.body: If maintainers do not want this branch updated, close the draft and keep the canonical issue as the product tracker for a future implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve with guardrails
recommendation.body: Allow local MEDIA reads only after the branch is rebased, fallback/dedupe defects are fixed, and live proof covers image-capable and unsupported terminals.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the TUI renderer and the adjacent image-generation tool path, making him the best available routing owner for the TUI/product boundary decision.
